visualBrief: Brest Hero Fortress as it stands today: the Star entrance, Kholm and Terespol gates, Saint Nicholas Garrison Church, surviving brick barracks and White Palace ruins, and the Courage, Thirst and Bayonet memorials.

photoFacing.frontBasis: The PMTiles polygons fix each building independently. The mapped walkways through Star, Kholm and Terespol give the individual passage axes and the river-facing façades. The Citadel frame is east-positive with the city to the northeast.
